text:
lucas: Handoff for tonight (US evening / EU morning) — short watchlist and quick actions. Main items: noisy KV-prefetcher alerts, two nodes in us-west-2 went into Drain state during maintenance and recovered but still showing odd eviction counts. Leaving details below. :eyes:

marta: ack — I'm taking coverage for first 3 hours. Will watch the prefetched keys alert and the node eviction metric. 😅

samira: quick note — prefetched-key spike looks correlated with one heavy ML batch job that started at 18:12 UTC. I pushed a temporary rate-limit to the job; monitoring for drop.

anya: FYI I muted the noisy alert rule for 20m to reduce pager fatigue while we confirm root cause. Alert: `kv_prefetcher.high_rate` firing ~every 2m. Muted via: `ops/alerts -> kv_prefetcher.high_rate -> mute 20m` :thumbsup:

lucas: thanks. Action items: 1) if `kv_prefetcher.error_rate` > 0.5% for >5m, escalate to infra-run (samira). 2) if evictions spike on drained nodes (>100/min) — move traffic away from that AZ.

oncall-bot: Note added to handoff: "watch kv-prefetcher noisy alerts; monitor drained nodes in us-west-2 for eviction spike" (id: hb-2026-045).

marta: checking current metrics: console link https://grafana.redwood.local/d/kv-prefetcher — prefetched keys QPS peaked at 9k around 18:15, now down to 1.2k. Evictions show a small tail in node i-0a1b2c3 (~45 total last 15m).

samira: I rolled back the batch job throttle to 50% (was 100%) and requeued some tasks. If we see another spike, we should consider adding a cache-warming policy instead of bulk prefetch.

anya: small config note for oncall: if you need to temporarily silence, prefer 15m windows and leave a terse reason. Helps runbook teams.

lucas: FYI there was a recent k8s upgrade on that us-west-2 pool yesterday — nodes briefly reported kubelet 1 minor warning about eviction thresholds; not sure it's related but worth keeping an eye.

marta: marking two known flaky alerts in watchlist: `kv_prefetcher.rate` (noisy on batch runs) and `node.eviction_tail` (spikes after node drains). I'll add to pager docs and add sample dashboards.

samira: if anyone gets a page for this tonight: first step: check `batch-job-controller` logs for recent large jobs, then check `prefetcher` QPS and `error_rate`. Typical fix is throttle + restart the prefetcher pod on that node pool.

lucas: also note: routing policy fallback to smaller model variant triggered once during the spike — app teams saw a ~50ms latency bump. Not critical but flagging.

deploy-bot: Deploy k8s/batch-controller@v2.14.1 -> success (2026-04-21T18:45:00Z).

anya: leaving for the night at 19:10 UTC; samira tagging in at 19:15. marta on standby for paging. Ping `@oncall` if anything escalates. :wave:

marta: will post an update in #eng-oncall if anything changes. Good handoff, thanks.
